ordinary_acl_definition: Same canonical packet, recipient/digest/lineage/seal and current dependency/epoch predicate before writing. Receiver-local transaction; seal consumption in a separate policy operation; no mature committed-receipt adapter. Existing constraints are retained. This is a deliberately explicit non-atomic ACL control, not all ACL implementations.
strong_reference: agent_memory_gateway.delivery.deliver directly; GatewayService.commit_transfer uses that same unmodified delivery/store core. No privileged recovery adapter for Gateway only.
input_pairing: One closed database/spool template copied per method. Packets, source truth, authorization events, fault schedule and ACK sink are shared. No historical experiment database is writable input.
recovery_scope: Fresh worker processes and a Harness-persisted fixed recovery manifest. Does not claim an autonomous product recovery scheduler exists.
timing_scope: Saved-packet decoding, opening/checking, durable receiver acceptance and close until metadata return. Excludes process startup, source registration/memory generation/prepare and ACK sink fsync. SQL counts are logical statements, not physical I/O.
engineering_acceptance_gate: The common safety oracle is unchanged for all methods. Record ACL PASS or FAIL as observed; no requirement for ACL to fail. Strong transaction and Gateway must satisfy every fixed scenario. Baseline limitation is not artifact invalidity.
scope: Controlled single-host SQLite process-fault engineering checks; no commercial Agent or distributed exactly-once claim. B=C security outcomes are an acceptable expected result. No E-over-strong-baseline advantage is assumed.
